item.title: MasterCraft To Acquire Marine Products In $232.2 Million Cash-And-Stock Deal
item.description: MasterCraft Boat Holdings and Marine Products have entered into a definitive agreement for MasterCraft to acquire Marine Products in a cash and stock transaction valued at approximately $232.2 million, net of acquired cash. The companies said the deal would combine five recreational marine brands across four categories, bringing together MasterCraft, Crest and Balise with Marine Products’ Chaparral and Robalo. item.title: Colliers Buys California Transit Engineering Specialist Ramos Consulting Services
item.description: Colliers has acquired Ramos Consulting Services, a California-based provider of program management, construction management, and engineering services for major public transit projects, as Colliers Engineering & Design’s U.S. business looks to deepen its presence in one of the country’s most active transit markets. The companies did not disclose financial terms, and Ramos’ senior leadership will continue to lead the transit business in California while becoming significant shareholders in Collier

item.description: Linq, a Birmingham, Alabama-based startup building a communications layer for AI agents, has raised a $20 million Series A round led by TQ Ventures, with participation from Mucker Capital and angel investors, including a former Apple and Google executive. item.description: LG Energy Solution and Stellantis announced they have agreed that LG Energy Solution will acquire full ownership of NextStar Energy, with Stellantis selling its 49% equity stake to its founding joint venture partner. item.title: P10 To Buy Stellus Capital Management For $250 Million
item.description: P10 announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Stellus Capital Management, a U.S. direct lender focused on senior secured loans to sponsor-backed lower-middle market companies, in a deal that would add roughly $3.8 billion of assets under management to P10’s platform. item.title: Gencom Buys The Ritz-Carlton New York, Central Park
item.description: Gencom announced it has acquired The Ritz-Carlton New York, Central Park, adding a 253-key luxury hotel at 50 Central Park South to its portfolio and marking the firm’s third luxury hotel purchase in New York City in the past 16 months. item.title: Beast Industries Buys Step To Add Youth-Focused Financial Services
item.description: Beast Industries, the creator-led entertainment and consumer products company founded by YouTube star Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), has acquired Step, a fintech app focused on financial literacy and money management for younger users. item.title: Clear Channel Outdoor Agrees To $6.2 Billion Take-Private Deal

item.title: Marzetti To Buy Bachan’s Japanese Barbecue Sauce Brand For $400 Million
item.description: The Marzetti Company announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Bachan’s, the fast-growing Japanese Barbecue Sauce brand, in a deal valued at $400 million. The transaction is intended to deepen Marzetti’s position in the condiment and sauce category by adding a clean-label, premium brand tied to consumer demand for global flavors and “better-for-you” products.
